how: We read the website of every Los Angeles wedding videographer listed on Lazo (206 listings, 157 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day marriage services, a DJ company, photographers with no video offering, a production house whose site is about music composition, and a national chain's Orange County page. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Will the ceremony audio come from lapel mics and the DJ board, or only from the camera? Beach and rooftop wind eats dialogue.
What is the delivery window for the highlight film and the full-length edit, and is the raw footage available?
Do you fly a drone, and have you checked the venue's and the city's rules on it? Much of Los Angeles is restricted airspace.

picks.name: Charles Lauren Films
picks.blurb: David Charles and Kelsey Lauren Pluskat named Charles Lauren Films after their middle names and have been making wedding films in Southern California since 2004. Packages are chosen simply by how long a wedding film you want, and the pitch is a film that is funny, cute and historical because it is about you.

picks.name: EverTwo Films | Wedding Videography & Photography
picks.blurb: A Los Angeles team of videographers and photographers that has filmed over 300 weddings and treats the logistics as part of the craft. EverTwo Films recommends an engagement shoot to get comfortable with the team first, and delivers cinematic films alongside photo galleries.

picks.name: Lovesaver Weddings
picks.blurb: LoveSaver Weddings makes cinematic wedding films from a deep film foundation: Nadin has more than 15 years in film directing and editing and Serge over ten in cinematography. A husband-and-wife team from Ukraine, based in Los Angeles, with photography from the same pair if you want one crew.

picks.name: Another Dream | Wedding Photo & Video
picks.blurb: Another Dream is a small team in Glendora making wedding photos and films meant to feel the way the day did, not posed or performative, for more than eight years across California. The site promises no hidden fees, and every package includes a signed contract, liability insurance and secure backups.

picks.name: West Films - Los Angeles Wedding Videographer
picks.blurb: Igor got into film in high school, made shorts, and then realized he would rather capture love stories. West Films is his destination wedding videography business based in California, with Los Angeles as home turf, and the site prints its film pricing instead of hiding it behind a form.

picks.name: The Shalom Imaginative
picks.blurb: The Shalom Imaginative shoots video and photo as one collective in a candid, documentary style, a decade on from when Nate and Amanda started it as a two-person team. Starting prices are printed on the site, from $3,600, and the studio says everyone is welcome.

picks.name: Call It Captivation Films
picks.blurb: Matt Tauro has filmed love stories near and far since 2016, with films that honor faith, family and legacy. Call It Captivation is based in Los Angeles and available for destination weddings worldwide, with full films by couple name on the site.

picks.name: Blushing Bride Photo Video
picks.blurb: Weddings have been part of the founder and lead videographer's life for more than 25 years, including work at venues like the Disneyland Resort. Blushing Bride Photo Video covers Los Angeles, Orange, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Ventura and Riverside counties with both photo and video.

picks.name: The I Do Wedding Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: A studio of photographers and filmmakers that grew out of two film-industry transplants shooting their first wedding; The I Do now counts more than 500. Indian, Persian and intercultural weddings are the specialty, filmed in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York and Arizona.

picks.name: Jimmy Shin Films
picks.blurb: Jimmy Shin once said he did not need a wedding video and calls skipping one the only thing he regrets; now he makes story-driven cinematic films so other couples do not. Based in Torrance, filming Los Angeles weddings and available worldwide.

picks.name: A Shot Of Love Films
picks.blurb: Caitlin Pitt graduated from Loyola Marymount University in 2017 with a degree in film production and has freelanced full time since. A Shot of Love Films makes what she calls badass, personality-driven wedding films for fun-loving couples, from castles to intimate ceremonies.

picks.name: Lulan Studio
picks.blurb: Lulan Studio films weddings alongside its photography, with the same cinematic, magazine-style approach Lulan Wang built the studio on in 2016. Collections combine video and stills from one team, and the site lets you choose your city before browsing what is included.
